artifacts.summary: Compile-verified design for the countermodel half of BimodalLib: a PointTruth-generic CountermodelEntry type, both TRANSFER theorems, first entries for all three grades (semantic in L and L+, certificate at ZTime, gated tableau via the gate theorem on explicit branch data), lookup up to atom renaming from the existing matcher, and two measured blockers -- the pipeline data file carries no branch, and part (5)'s near-miss reciprocity has no registry row to point at.
